name: LiveryOS — Operations
description: Daily operator view. All figures per tenant; currencies never blended.

cards.title: Bookings per day
cards.query: SELECT day, bookings, executive, sprinter FROM v_bi_bookings_per_day WHERE tenant = {{tenant}} ORDER BY day

cards.title: Fleet activity (active devices per hour)
cards.query: SELECT hour, active_devices FROM v_bi_fleet_activity WHERE tenant = {{tenant}} ORDER BY hour

cards.title: Flight adjustments
cards.query: SELECT day, auto_shifts, alerts FROM v_bi_flight_adjustments WHERE tenant = {{tenant}} ORDER BY day
